title: Affine complexes have sheaf Tor amplitude exactly when their module complexes do
statement: Let A be a ring and X = Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme]. Let M^\bullet be a complex of A-modules and let E be the corresponding object of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)\subseteq D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] under the affine quasi-coherent derived equivalence [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence]. For integers a\le b, the following are equivalent: (i) E has Tor amplitude in [a,b], meaning that H^i(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)=0 for every \mathcal O_X-module \mathcal G and every i\notin[a,b]; (ii) M^\bullet has Tor amplitude in [a,b], meaning that H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N)=0 for every A-module N and every i\notin[a,b].
